P.name: Gift of the Drowned Ones
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pyke's''' {{sti|health|{{as|'''maximum''' health}}}} cannot increase except through [[Growth#Increasing_Statistics|growth (per level)]], instead he gains{{ft|{{sti|{{as|1 '''bonus''' attack damage}}}} {{as|per 14 '''bonus''' health}}.|{{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{fd|7.143}}% of '''bonus''' health}}.}}
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pyke''' gains {{as|1 '''bonus''' movement speed}} while in the river.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pyke''' stores 9% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.2}}% per 1 Lethality)}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes from enemy {{tip|champions}} as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], increased to 40% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.4}}% per 1 Lethality)}} while there are two or more {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions nearby. He can store up to 80 {{as|(+ 800% '''bonus''' AD)}} [[Health#Grey health|grey health]], with an upper cap of {{as|55% of his '''maximum''' health}}.
P.description4: While '''Pyke''' is not {{tip|sight|visible}} to enemies, he rapidly consumes his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to {{tip|heal}} for the same amount.

Q.name: Bone Skewer
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% for up to 3 seconds to increase ''Bone Skewer's'' {{sti|range}} over the first second of the channel. ''Bone Skewer'' can be recast within the duration.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Pyke''' hurls his harpoon in the target direction, becoming {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} while it is in flight and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|airborne|pulling}} them, during which they are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}, then {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 90% for 1 second.
Q.description3: Releasing the ability within {{fd|0.4}} seconds causes '''Pyke''' to instead thrust his blade in the target direction, dealing the same damage to the closest enemy {{tip|champion}}, or closest enemy otherwise.
Q.description4: If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} or completes without reactivation, ''Bone Skewer'' is cancelled and the ability is put on {{sti|cd|full}} cooldown but refunds {{sti|mana|{{as|75% of the mana cost}}}}. ''Bone Skewer's'' {{as|mana cost}} is also refunded if it hits an enemy champion.

W.name: Ghostwater Dive
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' submerges into water for 5 seconds, entering {{tip|camouflage}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|45%|ms}} {{as|(+ 2% per 1 Lethality)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over the duration. Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Ghostwater Dive'' immediately.
W.description2: ''Enemy champions within 1500 units of '''Pyke''' are alerted of his presence and whether he can execute them with {{ai|Death from Below|Pyke}}.''

E.name: Phantom Undertow
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, leaving behind a ''Phantom''. '''Pyke''' is {{tip|ghosted}} while the ''Phantom'' is active.
E.description2: After 1 second, the ''Phantom'' homes back to '''Pyke''' to {{tip|stun}} enemies around it and those it passes through along the way for {{fd|1.25}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.1}} per 10 Lethality)}} seconds. Enemy champions hit also take {{as|physical damage}}.

R.name: Death from Below
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pyke''' marks the target location with the shape of an ''X'' before striking it, {{tip|execute|executing}} enemy {{tip|champions}} within the area that are below {{as|{{pp|250;290;330;370;400;430;450;470;490;510;530;540;550|6 to 18}}|health}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}} per 1 Lethality)}} {{sti|{{as|health}}}}. Other enemies hit and enemy champions above the threshold are instead dealt{{ft|50% of the amount as {{as|physical damage}}.|{{as|{{pp|125;145;165;185;200;215;225;235;245;255;265;270;275|6 to 18}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.75}} per 1 Lethality)}} {{as|physical damage}}.}}
R.description2: If ''Death from Below'' hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or at least one is [[death|killed]] inside the ''X'' by the ''execution'' or an ally, '''Pyke''' will {{tip|blink}} to the center of the ''X''. For the latter case '''Pyke''' can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost.
R.description3: Each successful ''execution'' grants one ''{{ii|Your Cut}}'' to the last assisting ally, instead of its natural [[assist]] {{g|gold}}. Otherwise, '''Pyke''' is granted a ''{{ii|Your Cut}}'' for each enemy champion killed inside the ''X'' by an ally during ''Death from Below's'' cast time.
